text:
kevin: Heads-up: we're planning a bring-up for qtiny-int4 later today. Need a sanitized candidate pool + golden refresh. Target ~88k candidates, golden 1.8k, quickcheck 2.5k. Can we pause ingestion briefly to avoid label drift and anchoring artifacts?

sasha: timeline? i can orchestrate dedupe and the entropy-based stratified sampler. thinking embed-cluster first then fuzzyhash, followed by anchor-stitching to restore provenance.

leila: agree. proposed flow:
- 09:50 UTC: tokenizer-consistency pass (v3 vs v4) -> drop noisy tokenized outliers
- 10:05 UTC: embed-cluster prune (faiss hnsw) with cosine th=0.86
- 10:30 UTC: fuzzyhash sweep (th=0.80)
- 10:50 UTC: anchor-stitch + entropy stratify sample -> export quickcheck 2.5k
- 11:15 UTC: eval int4 vs qint8 on 1.8k golden holdout
If gates pass we'll promote. Abort if >2% precision loss or >2.5% hallucination increase.

curation-ops: noted. we'll pause label ingestion for channel "curation" from 09:45-12:00 UTC. requeue rule: any batch with >15% incomplete will be requeued. label-bot will post when paused.

dedupe-bot: scheduling pipeline:
```\npipeline: tokenizer-check -> embed-cluster -> fuzzyhash -> anchor-stitch\ntokenizer_check: v3_vs_v4\nembed_index: faiss-hnsw32\ncosine_threshold: 0.86\nfuzzy_threshold: 0.80\nentropy_stratify: true\nshards: 140\nquickcheck_sample: 2500\n```\nStarting tokenizer-check at 09:50 UTC, full pipeline aim complete by 10:50 UTC. Outputs -> s3://rwd-curation/qtiny/v2/dedupe/2026-03-23

label-bot: label ingestion paused at 09:45 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to resume.

infra-bot: pinned runtime image rwd-infer:2026-03-22-qtiny-int4, locked CUDA 12.1, autoscale disabled for job window. KV-cache warmup enabled. Reserving 2 GPUs for the eval run.

sasha: for anchor-stitching, we'll maintain provenance links to original corpora and add an anchor-id to any merged samples. This helps trace regressions back to source. Also we should avoid naive sampling-with-replace on small cohorts to prevent overrepresentation.

leila: quickcheck stratification plan: 30% longctx (>1024), 18% non-en, 12% code, 10% multi-turn, rest intent-diverse. i'll do manual spotcheck on the quickcheck and flag high-variance buckets.

kevin: eval-bot can you run a compact harness: token-delta, BLEU/ROUGE, QA exact-match precision, hallucination-detector, and p95 latency. Need per-sample diffs plus a top-40 regression list. Abort thresholds above. Also include token-level cost delta.

eval-bot: queued. expected outputs: per-sample CSV + top-40 regressions + aggregate metrics. will post when done.

curation-ops: ops note: requeue batches with annotator dropout >10% before 09:40. I'll run a soft drain.

label-bot: reminder: paused. Resume requires explicit :white_check_mark:.

leila: small pre-step: run token-walk cleaning to drop trailing html/js artifacts. i've seen these spike token lengths and confuse embed-clusters. will run at 09:52 UTC.

sasha: good call. also enable a short sanity dedupe pass with ngram overlap to catch small near-duplicates after fuzzyhash.

dedupe-bot: added post-fuzzy ngram-scan (ngram=5, overlap_th=0.7) to pipeline.

kevin: perf estimate? need tokens, est compute, p95. we'll compare int4 vs qint8 cost.

infra-bot: perf estimate: ~21.2M tokens -> int4 compute est $330 (gpu-hours ~4.8). qint8 fallback est $470. p95 latency est 310ms.

leila: i'll do manual spotcheck on quickcheck and post a short summary: top discrepancies, any residual duplicates, and a few example failures to root cause. will call out if tokenization mismatches caused dropouts.

kevin: thanks. team, keep thread minimal during the run; only post regressions/blockers. i'll publish go/no-go after eval-bot outputs.

eval-bot: starting preliminary int4 vs qint8 smoke run at ~11:15 UTC once quickcheck/golden ready. expect CSV in ~20-30m.
